principle: Lead with a genuinely useful original research asset or correction, never a generic backlink request.

priorityAudiences.angle: new aggregate evidence findings or material evidence changes
transparent evidence-literacy and research reference resources
source-backed safety research and uncertainty framing
reusable data and charts with explicit caveats
meaningful evidence changes rather than generic site promotion

guardrails: Do not pay for editorial backlinks.
Do not claim authority or credentials the site does not possess.
Do not auto-disavow suspicious links; surface them for review.
Do not pitch a statistic unless its source object and date are available.
Deduplicate outreach by referring domain before contact.
Prefer corrections and useful replacement data over reciprocal-link asks.
